short: Codec-latent flow decoder (M06) is standard: quality lead rests on predictors that rate output above ground truth; WER trails V2SFlow; speaker similarity uses reference audio.
position: SLD-L2S [@liang2026sldl2s] changes the decoder (M06) to flow matching on continuous neural-codec latents, a target found in 1 of 165 video-to-speech studies but never isolated from the rest of the system, so the component is standard. Its quality lead rests on reference-free predictors that score output above the recordings, at the same 10 steps as the cited but uncompared Faces-to-Voices [@kim2025faces]; WER trails V2SFlow [@choi2024v2sflow], and the speaker-similarity ranking mixes systems with and without a reference-audio embedding.
